creation_gate.description: Creation gate while no pre-propose module is installed. Default `ProposerGate {}` (legacy).

dao.description: DAO DAO core address. Default: the instantiator (a DAO core instantiates its proposal modules, exactly like dao-proposal-single, which uses `info.sender`).

min_submit_stake.description: Required: minimum bonded stake (bond denom) of the assignee to submit work; "0" disables. No default.

min_upload_stake.description: Required: minimum bonded stake (bond denom) to upload documents through the CID storage service (checked off chain via `can_upload`); "0" disables. No default.

params_placeholder.description: Required: true while the values are unvoted placeholders.

params_version.description: Required label of this parameter set; no default.

pre_propose_info.description: dao-voting pre-propose config. Default `AnyoneMayPropose {}` (then `creation_gate` applies). `ModuleMayPropose { info }` instantiates the module (admin = dao) and gives it exclusive creation rights once its instantiate reply arrives (fails open to Anyone until then, as upstream).

Admin.description: Information about the CosmWasm level admin of a contract. Used in conjunction with `ModuleInstantiateInfo` to instantiate modules.

oneOf.description: Set the admin to a specified address.
Sets the admin as the core module address.

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

CreationGate.description: Who may create a bounty while the creation policy is `Anyone {}` (no pre-propose module). When a pre-propose module is installed (`ProposalCreationPolicy::Module`), that module is the gate and this setting is not consulted.

oneOf.description: Legacy behaviour: the `ProposerGate` (allowlist / min_stake / cw4, any passes).
(a) Anyone may deposit and create a bounty. Listing still needs the approver.
(b) The sender's bonded stake in the chain bond denom (same `bonded()` check as `ProposerGate.min_stake` and the submit/upload gates) must be >= `amount`. `amount` > 0.

(c) TODO, NOT IMPLEMENTED: a sound, private proof that the proposer deposited into an escrow on a counterparty chain (e.g. Zcash shielded) without revealing the deposit details. See DESIGN.md §9. Instantiate/update_config reject it and create would fail with `Unimplemented`.

ModuleInstantiateInfo.description: Information needed to instantiate a module.

admin.description: CosmWasm level admin of the instantiated contract. See: <https://docs.cosmwasm.com/docs/1.0/smart-contracts/migration>

code_id.description: Code ID of the contract to be instantiated.

funds.description: Funds to be sent to the instantiated contract.

msg.description: Instantiate message to be used to create the contract.

salt.description: Salt to use with instantiate2, if defined. Otherwise uses normal instantiate.

oneOf.description: Anyone may create a proposal free of charge.
The module specified in INFO has exclusive rights to proposal creation.

Uint256.description:
An implementation of u256 that is using strings for JSON encoding/decoding, such that the full u256 range can be used for clients that convert JSON numbers to floats, like JavaScript and jq.

# Examples

Use `new` to create instances out of u128, `from` for other primitive uint types or `from_be_bytes` to provide big endian bytes:

``` # use cosmwasm_std::Uint256; let a = Uint256::new(258u128); let b = Uint256::from(258u16); let c = Uint256::from_be_bytes([ 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 0u8, 1u8, 2u8, ]); assert_eq!(a, b); assert_eq!(a, c); ```
